reviews.text:
I ordered Velda antifreeze and aerator for my garden pond. The product works perfectly and the delivery was fast. There was a cute message with a tea bag attached to the product, which I really appreciate. A nice gesture.
I can only recommend it!!
Huge selection. Great expertise.

I had perfect service
(thanks for the secret exit too, it was a big help as a pedestrian)
Correct customer communication, fast delivery, and I especially appreciate that they surprised me with a bag of green tea along with the pebbles. 🙂 …
Great deal, I can only recommend it.
Kind, professional service, ample selection. We will be back :)
I was looking for aquatic plants for my aquarium, the lady working was very helpful, I found quality plants at a good price, huge selection. Relatively easy to find, parking provided.

Super clear website, fast delivery, I am very satisfied!
Thank you!
We have found a normal trade again in this fast-paced world, thank you very much
Only half of the order was in the box, I reported the shortage and they sent the missing product practically immediately. I think the plants are beautiful and were carefully packaged.
Fantastically fast delivery! I ordered it in the morning, received it the next morning. The best customer service I've ever encountered!
I love it, I've been coming here for 25 years, helpful staff
Very nice sellers, fast service!!

I received the plants today.
For more than 10,000 forints, pieces of plants that were cut up and thrown together, 8 cm diameter, weak-leafed colocans, groups of floating plants the size of tablespoons.
I suggest that they ask what and how much they are actually sending, because then maybe they won't disappoint.
I am very satisfied with the product I received, the company is responsive and the communication is good. Thank you very much :)
Fast, reliable, and I received very nice goods. I can only recommend them.

I ordered from aqua pet twice as I needed plants and equipment for my new pond. I was very happy both times! They have a great selection of pond plants and equipment, and everything is reasonably priced. I would recommend!
I received such beautiful plants, the shop is among the first, they are kind, and of course I get a little something every time. I highly recommend the shop to everyone.
They are very nice and try to make the package personal. That's a big positive.
Very kind, helpful, reliable company with high quality! Thank you!
Reliable, fair webshop. Beautiful plants, precise packaging.

Lightning fast delivery, careful packaging, and a little surprise! Thank you very much!
I can't wait for the pond rose flowers to decorate my pond.

Reliable online store, complaint handling is also very fair.
I will shop here again.
I received the package a little late, I missed communication, but in the end the owner quickly solved the problem and was helpful.

Very dirty!
The surroundings are messy.
Fair business, prepared salespeople

We contacted them personally, we wanted to buy a pond filter, they explained everything down to the smallest detail about the filters and their cleaning. I can only say good things about them!☺️Friendly service!🤗 …

There are quite a lot of goods, although not of everything, but you don't have to wait so long to get in line anywhere (we bought the plant we had picked out in advance in 1.5 hours), and the place isn't the cleanest and it's cramped... Only come here if you don't mind spending half your day here.
This place has everything for fish and pond enthusiasts!

Very fast delivery, great products!
If I could I would give more stars! The little “plus” address on the box made my day, and I didn’t even mention the little gift!! I can only recommend it!!! 🥰 …
I ordered the plants a few days ago, they arrived fresh, as if they had just been taken out of the water.
I ordered 3 pond plants to reduce organic matter in our small pond. They arrived quickly, very carefully packaged, and with a little water, healthy, large plants.
A wide range of pond plants for early spring, accurate, precise order delivery. The package label already brought a smile to my face, and a cute gift awaited me next to it.

I really like this store. There is a large selection, excellent professional standards. Unfortunately, it is in a rather dilapidated condition, it could use development and modernization. It is in a very secluded place, far from everything.
They are fast and accurate. We received super well-assembled, carefully packaged products. Last but not least, thank you for the gift! 🤗 …

I am very satisfied, we placed the order on Monday evening, and we received it on Wednesday. We received a fast, precise, and beautiful product (water lily).
Special thanks for the little attention.
I can only recommend it.
They are fast, reliable, customer-friendly and kind service.
Professional, fast, enthusiastic
Excellent store, huge selection, great professional experience!
Dear Marcell, I would like to ask what your problem was? Why were you not satisfied enough to rate me 1 star? Thank you for your answer so that we can learn and improve from our mistake.
Despite its run-down appearance, the place is a great shop. The salesman was able to provide a lot of information about aquariums. We will come again.

We went for plants. At first I was scared that we were in the wrong place, but then the iron door opened.🥰
A nice gentleman served us, expertly and willingly. The stock of plants, animals and equipment is large.
We will definitely come again!
P.S.: I really like that it is not a fancy place! The expertise and the stock of goods are the main thing! 👍✌️
Very fast delivery, a thoughtful message on the box. I will order from them again!
Fast professional! I got what I asked for!
Kind, professional, knowledgeable service. Everything available in aquariums can be found here.
Everything about aquariums....
It arrived very quickly, exquisite packaging!
It's a shame I didn't find it sooner. The owner, who deals with fish, is very helpful, he shared a lot of good advice and his own experiences with us during the shopping.
Professional and kind
Kind helpful service!
Lightning-fast delivery, a small gift, a nice personalized note, a discount on your next order. This is a customer-friendly attitude.

I am very satisfied. Fast delivery, I was informed about every step of the purchase, delivery, great and thoughtful packaging. The products arrived in order, it was a wonderful shopping experience with a personalized label and coupon code. I will definitely buy from them again!
Lots of things available and good prices, nice service

Fantastic team, always a little attention.
I only buy from them. Take a look around too ❤️

Great store. I received the ordered products quickly! I recommend it to everyone!
Thank you :)
(ps.: they even gave me a little gift :) )
Very helpful staff combined with a great selection
Very helpful team!

Very wide selection, friendly service. Pet shop
Also sells aquarium items.

This is not a fancy bakery, but a shop with a huge selection, with kind and helpful staff. I ordered a plant from them, which was nicely packaged and mailed, so it is growing nicely :)
I can only recommend the place!
Incredibly fast and accurate service, thank you

The store is in a pretty hard to find location and not very organized. The staff was extremely nice and helpful, but the prices were missing/wrongly displayed in several places. Honestly, the total price shocked me, but all the rooms are good.
Very prepared and helpful team! I can only recommend it!
Fast and accurate delivery.
I recommend it! ☺️
Friendly and knowledgeable staff, recommended
All products are flawless and I received beautiful plants. All orders arrive quickly.
The order, delivery, and payment went smoothly. The product is great. And the extra little attention was also excellent. Thank you.
Very fast, dear.

I have ordered from here several times, good prices and fair service.
The tea was also very delicious. ☺️

I received nice, large, well-developed, healthy plants. A special highlight is that you don't have to worry about cleaning the rock wool because it arrived already cleaned. Recommended Hungarian company.
Very good little things deserve 5 stars!😊❤️ …
Super expertise, very kind, fair and helpful shop. 10/10
Thank you for your review. We look forward to welcoming you again next time.
Fast, kind, reliable 🤗 …

I bought my internet from them.
They work with very fair prices and the delivery was very fast.
Thank you very much.
Personalized box with a little gift inside! They are fast and reliable.
I snagged some products for our favorite as part of their huge sale, and they delivered them the next day. Everything was great!

I searched Google for a more powerful branded aquarium filter (jbl 1902) and randomly chose this company. I called them on the phone because I needed other things as well, since I was changing my aquarium from 100 to 260 and I felt I needed professional advice, because I was only self-taught.
A lady answered the phone and modestly said "she will try to help", then it finally turned out to me that she knows everything, even about plants!
I ordered the products almost at noon that day and received them the next day, and I am not from Budapest, carefully and separately packaged! Thank you!
Then a few days later I called this company again because I wanted to ask something but another lady answered the phone and she was also very helpful with appropriate expertise!
I will shop here again, I have added it to my favorites!
I recommend this company to others!
I bought my internet from them. They work with fair prices and delivery took surprisingly little time.
Good prices, fast delivery! Correct, attentive team! Thank you for the tea!🙂 …
